capability.summary: Check one Go source file with `gofmt -l -d` and return its listing and diff without rewriting it
capability.description: Runs gofmt's list-and-diff modes for one existing file. Formatting differences remain raw stdout text, and because no `-w` flag is used the source file is unchanged.
capability.problem_space: Read-only gofmt compliance preview for one Go source file; not formatting application, Go linting, compilation, testing, package traversal, or source rewriting.

env_requirements: gofmt executable from a Go toolchain
constraint.io_signature: Input: one required existing Go source file path; output: JSON process envelope with raw `gofmt -l -d` stdout/diff, stderr, and exit code.
accepted_inputs: an existing Go source file accepted by gofmt
constraint.output_shape: Completed check: {status: "success", tool: "gofmt", target: string, exit_code: 0, result: null, stdout: string, stderr: string|null}; nonempty stdout lists the file and/or shows the proposed diff, while already formatted input normally yields empty stdout. Nonzero gofmt result uses the same keys with status="tool_error" and propagates its exit code. Non-existing path, missing executable, or 120-second timeout: {status: "error", tool: "gofmt", message: string}, exiting 2/3/4. Missing argument prints usage to stderr and exits 1 without JSON.
limitations: fixed `-l -d` flags make this check-only; it never uses `-w` and never formats the file in place
gofmt normally exits 0 even when formatting changes are needed, so consumers must inspect stdout rather than exit_code alone
checks only the supplied path and does not discover Go packages or recursively walk a project
returns unparsed listing/diff text with result=null, uses a fixed 120-second timeout, and applies no output truncation

output_contract.description: JSON execution envelope containing raw gofmt list/diff stdout and process metadata; the Go source file is not modified.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: check whether a Go file matches gofmt
preview gofmt changes as a diff
negative_intents: apply gofmt or rewrite Go source files
run Go tests coverage builds or compilation
lint Go semantics or inspect an entire project recursively
